description: Return system health — running version, engram count, episode count, pack count, storage root. Optionally filter engram counts by domain prefix and/or creation date.

created_after.description: ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only count engrams learned on or after this date.

domain.description: Only count engrams whose domain starts with this prefix (e.g. "meridian")

name: plur_status
